answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 100 aliases needs 100 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The whisper test is the live device, the sparrow test is the locked stake, and the knoll test is the graded history no template can fake.
